help.text:
usage: dhcpig [-h]
              {exhaust,scan,active-scan,release,release-previous,restore,ifaces,report}
              ...

dhcpig command-line interface (V1.0). Subcommands: exhaust | scan | active-
scan | release | release-previous | restore | ifaces | report Exit codes: 0 ok
· 2 bad args · 3 no DHCP server · 130 interrupted

positional arguments:
  {exhaust,scan,active-scan,release,release-previous,restore,ifaces,report}
    exhaust             consume the DHCP pool (non-destructive)
    scan                passive ARP + DHCP fingerprint (read-only)
    active-scan         active discovery: ARP sweep + DHCP INFORM (needs
                        --scope)
    release             DHCPRELEASE in-scope neighbors (DESTRUCTIVE)
    release-previous    recover a drained pool by replaying the lease journal
                        (not destructive)
    restore             release leases acquired by a prior run
    ifaces              list usable interfaces
    report              re-render a saved JSON report

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

--active-scan-listen.help: how long to listen for replies after the ARP sweep/INFORM burst (default 20s)

--any-server.help: release even when the current server differs from the one recorded in the journal (default: skip mismatches, to avoid releasing on the wrong network)

--convert.help: regenerate the database from Satori's fingerprints/dhcp.xml and write it to --database, then exit

--database.help: lookup JSON beside this script by default

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--journal.help: override the journal location (default: the resolved per-interface path)

--max-age.help: ignore journal entries older than this many days (default 7)

--no-evict.help: skip ARP-conflict eviction of re-acquired addresses (default: on) -- see RFC 5227 SS2.4; release now shares the full exhaust chain (2.3, Phase 5)

--no-journal.help: don't record acquired leases to the recovery journal (default: on) -- without it, 'dhcpig release-previous' has nothing to recover with if this run is interrupted

--no-race-freed.help: skip racing a targeted DISCOVER for an address a live foreign NAK/DECLINE shows just became free (default: on) -- see docs/DESIGN.md §5g

--no-spoof-eth-src.help: use the real NIC MAC for all frames (Wi-Fi friendly)

--open.help: open the browser at the tokenized URL (default)

--passes.help: RELEASE has no reply (RFC 2131), so resend the selected set this many times as cheap insurance against a dropped frame (default 2)

--race-on-rediscover.help: also race on a foreign DISCOVER from a MAC our ARP inventory already has an IP for (default: off -- the highest-volume, lowest-precision trigger)

--scope.help: limit targets to these networks (default: the interface's own network)

--spoof-eth-src.help: ethernet src = client MAC (default; distinct L2 clients)

--status-interval.help: periodic status line with running stats (default 5s; 0 disables)

-v.help: Output detail, 0-3 (default 2). 0 prints results only (findings and the final summary); 1 is a compact one-character-per-packet stream; 2 is the normal packet-level log; 3 adds internal debug lines.

active-scan.help: active discovery: ARP sweep + DHCP INFORM (needs --scope)

fingerprint.help: one or more comma-separated Option 55 lists; reads stdin if omitted

release-previous.help: recover a drained pool by replaying the lease journal (not destructive)

restore.help: release leases acquired by a prior run
